theorems.name: Orion.DirectAttack.layered_invariants

theorem layered_invariants {S : Type u} {edge : S → S → Prop}
    (c : LayeredCertificate edge) (start : S)
    (hindex : c.index start = 0)
    (hC0 : ¬ c.C start) (hH0 : ¬ c.H start)
    (hK0 : ¬ c.K start) (hU0 : ¬ c.U start)
    {q : S} {t : Nat} (path : Walk edge start q t) :
    c.index q ≤ t ∧
    (c.C q → c.phiC q ≤ t) ∧
    (c.H q → c.phiH q ≤ t) ∧
    (c.K q → c.bound ≤ t + 1) ∧
    (c.U q → c.bound ≤ t)

theorems.name: ReflectionCoreCut.witness_final_unsafe
theorems.statement: theorem witness_final_unsafe : ¬ safe (run [] witnessPrefix)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.state_in_states
theorems.statement: theorem state_in_states : ∀ q : State, q ∈ states

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.letter_in_letters
theorems.statement: theorem letter_in_letters : ∀ letter : Letter, letter ∈ letters

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.initial_cardinality
theorems.statement: theorem initial_cardinality : cardinality (membership initialMask) = 17

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.seed
theorems.statement: theorem seed : initialMask ∈ layer 0

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.finite_closure
theorems.statement: theorem finite_closure : ∀ k : Fin 9, layerOK k.val = true

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.finite_safety
theorems.statement: theorem finite_safety : ∀ k : Fin 10, safeLayer k.val = true

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.cut_closed
theorems.statement:
theorem cut_closed (k : Fin 9) (S : Nat) (hS : S ∈ layer k.val) (letter : Letter) :
    pullMask letter S ∈ layer (k.val+1) ∧
      pre (membership S) letter = membership (pullMask letter S)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.cut_safe
theorems.statement:
theorem cut_safe (k : Fin 10) (S : Nat) (hS : S ∈ layer k.val) :
    ¬ goal (membership S)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.run_in_layers
theorems.statement:
theorem run_in_layers (word : List Letter) :
    ∀ k S, k + word.length ≤ 9 → S ∈ layer k → run S word ∈ layer (k+word.length)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.literal_run_bridge
theorems.statement:
theorem literal_run_bridge (word : List Letter) :
    ∀ k S, k + word.length ≤ 9 → S ∈ layer k →
      actualRun (membership S) word = membership (run S word)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.every_short_word_fails
theorems.statement:
theorem every_short_word_fails (word : List Letter) (hLength : word.length ≤ 9) :
    ¬ goal (actualRun (membership initialMask) word)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.witness_length
theorems.statement: theorem witness_length : witness.length = 10

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.witness_success
theorems.statement: theorem witness_success : goal (actualRun (membership initialMask) witness)

theorems.name: OrderTwoThreeABarrier.ordinary_minimum
theorems.statement:
theorem ordinary_minimum :
    (∃ word : List Letter, word.length = 10 ∧ goal (actualRun (membership initialMask) word)) ∧
    (∀ word : List Letter, word.length < 10 → ¬ goal (actualRun (membership initialMask) word))
